name: negotiate

test_list.description: Equal majors negotiate to that major and the lower of the two minors.
A differing major version fails with VersionMismatch carrying both versions.
Major 0 (unset / default message) is never compatible, even with itself.
negotiate(a, b) equals negotiate(b, a) whenever it succeeds.
The S0-12 guest handshake (single integer 1 accepted, host 2 refused) maps to major equality against PROTOCOL_VERSION.
A protobuf ProtocolVersion with a major or minor above u16::MAX converts to OutOfRange, never truncates.
ProtocolVersion displays as major.minor (1.0, 12.34), the form used in VersionMismatch messages.
For arbitrary versions: Ok exactly when majors are equal and non-zero, and the result is (major, min(minor)).

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The version announced by the peer in the handshake.

output_description: The version both sides will speak, or VersionMismatch when the major versions differ or are zero.
